description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveTerminationReasonController' that handles the pre-rendering logic for managing termination reasons in the OrangeHRM system, specifically deciding which Vue component to load based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the HTTP request.

classes.name: SaveTerminationReasonController
classes.description: A controller that prepares the appropriate Vue component for rendering termination reason management, depending on whether an existing termination reason ID is provided in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on the request parameters. If an 'id' parameter exists, sets up the component for editing, passing the 'id' as a prop; otherwise, sets up the component for creating a new termination reason.
